tierReason: Idea responses gain separate like/dislike counts (API change) plus mobile UI fixes for idea detail, ideas list and task assign

findings.text: apps/mobile/src/ui/Screen.tsx KeyboardAvoidingView: behavior is now 'padding' on Android too, for every Screen. If the Android window still resizes for the keyboard (no edge-to-edge), padding double-applies and leaves a gap above the keyboard. Needs an Android device check (Test Handoff).

apps/mobile/src/ideas/voteCounts.ts: fallback for ideas without counts uses max(score,0)/max(-score,0), so an old cached idea with 3 likes and 2 dislikes shows 1 and 0 until the next fetch replaces it.

apps/mobile/src/tasks/comments/CommentComposer.tsx onFocus: reveal waits for keyboardDidShow, so with a hardware keyboard (soft keyboard hidden) no scroll happens; the input isn't covered then, and on-device behaviour for acceptance 7 is unverified.

apps/api/src/ideas/response.ts:26-27: separate like/dislike counts reveal more about how members voted than score did; in a tiny project members may infer who voted which way. Spec asks for it; note in change report.

apps/mobile/src/ideas/voteCounts.ts: against a server without this change the fallback guesses counts from score (2 likes + 1 dislike shows 1 and 0). Display only; deploy the API before or with the app build.

1.evidence: Code reading: IdeaRow VoteColumn shows thumbs-up/down each with own count, no arrows. Not seen on a device. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
1.criterion: Open a project's Ideas list: each row shows a thumbs-up with a number and a thumbs-down with a number, no arrows, no shared number. With 3 likes and 1 dislike from different members, the row shows 3 and 1.

2.evidence: Code reading: BigVote is icon+count only; no Support/Against/Ủng hộ/Không vote labels in en/vi. Not seen on a device. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
2.criterion: Open an idea: the vote area shows thumbs-up and thumbs-down icons with their counts, and no "Support"/"Against" text in either language.

3.evidence: Count arithmetic covered by overlay/voteCounts/store tests (pass); pressed state and airplane-mode sync not checked on a device. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
3.criterion: Tap like: like count +1 and the like icon shows pressed. Tap like again: back to before. Tap dislike while liked: like -1, dislike +1. Same in airplane mode, and it syncs after reconnecting. Automated tests cover the count arithmetic for set, clear and switch.

4.evidence: routes.test.ts 'returns likeCount and dislikeCount from the list, detail and vote routes' asserts likeCount 2, dislikeCount 1, score 1 on all three routes; API suite 867/867 passed.
4.criterion: API test: an idea with two +1 votes and one -1 vote returns `likeCount: 2`, `dislikeCount: 1`, `score: 1`, from list, detail and vote routes.

5.evidence: Diff inspection: sort logic (order.ts) unchanged; counts are display-only; existing listRules ordering tests pass.
5.criterion: With ideas of differing votes, the list shows them in the same order as before this change.

6.evidence: Code reading: CommentComposer now renders after the list and load-more in shared CommentsSection used by idea and task detail; not seen rendered.
6.criterion: On idea detail and task detail, existing comments appear above the comment input.

7.evidence: Screen KeyboardAvoidingView padding on both platforms + scroll-into-view on focus/typing (helper unit-tested); needs a real phone, iOS and Android. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
7.criterion: On a phone, tap the comment input on an idea with many comments and photos: the screen scrolls so the input is visible above the keyboard; typing several lines keeps the text visible. Same on task detail.

8.evidence: AssigneeField scrolls the opened list into view next frame; needs a phone. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
8.criterion: On task new/edit, with the assignee field near the bottom of the screen, tap it: the list opens and is scrolled into view.

9.evidence: Code reading: each assignee row has Avatar with initialOf(displayName), muted for former members; not seen on a device. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
9.criterion: Each person in the assignee list has a letter avatar matching their name's initial.

10.evidence: parity.test.ts passes; likeA11y/dislikeA11y with count and viewer's vote, rowA11y without Score; screen reader not tried. Test Handoff in issue #47 section K; user will check on a phone later.
10.criterion: Screen reader reads like/dislike with counts and the viewer's vote; `src/i18n/parity.test.ts` passes.
